summary: Verified WorkMate AI personalization upgrade. All 16 new backend tests pass covering /api/memory GET/DELETE, /api/me/stats, chat personalization (name injection + Source line + background memory extraction), server-side title search (?q=), PATCH archived, per-user ownership 404 isolation for GET/PATCH/DELETE conversations and messages, and company-scoped /api/stats. Frontend regressions all pass: employee login+session persistence, 'Hello, Sarah.' greeting, chat-activity-strip (25 conversations / 37 messages / 4 things I remember), Recent list with clickable recent-conv-* items, sidebar conv-search-input (server-side filter returns only hr-titled convs), AI memory popover with 4 facts and working Clear memory button (empties to 0), suggested-0 sends message with streaming response ending in 'Source:' line, thumbs up/down present, submit-leave-request-btn and submit-it-support-btn present in header. Admin dashboard: all six sidebar tabs render (dashboard/knowledge/employees/settings/automations/feedback), stats cards Employees=5, Documents=4, Conversations=25 all populated.

DELETE /api/memory -> {ok:true}; subsequent GET returns facts=[]
GET /api/memory without auth -> 401/403
GET /api/me/stats returns {total_conversations, active_conversations, total_messages, recent, memory_count}

GET /api/conversations?q=hr returns only titles containing 'hr' (case-insensitive)
PATCH /api/conversations/{own} with {status:'archived'} -> 200 status=archived
PATCH /api/conversations/{other user's id} -> 404
GET /api/conversations/{id}/messages own -> 200 list; other -> 404
DELETE /api/conversations/{other user's id} -> 404; DELETE own -> 200 then GET messages -> 404
GET /api/stats admin -> 200 {employees, documents, conversations, messages, active_users_7d} all ints; employee -> 403
Memory isolation: clearing admin memory does NOT affect Sarah's memory
UI: Sarah login -> /chat; refresh persists session (employee-chat still present)

test_credentials: admin@technova.com / admin123 ; sarah@technova.com / employee123 ; ahmed@technova.com / employee123
seed_data_creation: Test uses existing seeded TechNova data + creates temporary conversations via /chat/stream inside the test class; own-conversation deletion cleans up
critical_code_review_comments: build_system_prompt() cleanly injects USER PROFILE block and remembered facts while preserving the strict Source: rule. Behaviorally verified end-to-end: Sarah's name appears in the reply and Source: leave_policy.pdf line is present. Good.

Memory extractor uses asyncio.create_task(extract_memory_background) after the SSE stream — non-blocking and 8s wait was sufficient in all runs. Failure is silent (logged) — acceptable degradation as specified.
PATCH /api/conversations uses raw dict payload (payload: dict) — works but consider a Pydantic model for stricter validation (title length, status enum). Minor.

server.py is now ~815 lines; approaching but under the 700 threshold nag zone — consider splitting routes (auth / conversations / memory / admin) into separate files in a future refactor. Not blocking.

Fire-and-forget task uses asyncio.create_task inside async generator; note that in some Starlette+uvicorn versions tasks scheduled after 'yield' can be cancelled if the client disconnects. Currently works, but for defense you may want a BackgroundTasks alternative. Not a bug today.
/api/stats now uses distinct('user_id', ...) for active_users_7d — correct company-scoped scoping verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files exist: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_session.py, /app/backend/tests/test_webhooks_prod.py, /app/backend/tests/test_personalization.py — run all with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Personalization tests create 2 conversations for Sarah, archive one, delete one, and rely on ~9s sleep for memory extraction. Frontend testids to know: employee-chat, chat-activity-strip, conv-search-input, ai-memory-btn, ai-memory-popover, memory-fact-<i>, clear-memory-btn, recent-conv-<id>, suggested-<i>, chat-input, chat-send-btn, thumb-up-<id>, thumb-down-<id>, submit-leave-request-btn, submit-it-support-btn. Admin dashboard label for Settings is 'AI Settings' but nav-settings testid works.
